scope: Confirmed authoring/fixture contracts only; not a complete native Atlas catalog or real-backend coverage statement.

next_batch.purpose: Close competing-writer and fixture resource-admission defects, and complete safe typed-record authoring.

items.requirement: One selected writer for every exact entity/field scope.
items.observed: Validator checks that a writer exists but permits two modules to declare the same field scope.
items.bounded_action: Reject conflicting writer declarations before saving or fixture execution. Preserve distinct observation fields and disjoint scopes.
acceptance: Duplicate writers rejected even without a sampled fact
Distinct entity/field scopes remain valid
Fact producer must match the selected writer

items.requirement: Capacity, observed availability and atomic reservation are different.

items.bounded_action: Add explicitly configured fixture-only admission using timed available-capacity evidence and authored request order, with a charging contention case.
acceptance: One slot admits at most one simultaneous request
Missing/stale/conflicting availability stays UNKNOWN
No implicit control arbitration, real charger actuation or physical charging success
remaining_limits: Fixture-only; no authenticated durable live resource authority
